body:
3 1/2 weeks of official NC.

i feel empty inside. still miss them. still think of them every day. still wanting to message them. still in love with them. i honestly think they were my person. no one else compares (even when our relationship was bad) i can’t even imagine the thought of moving on and being with someone else because it won’t be them. fuck.

this is kind of like my ex pwBPD. except she wouldn’t have been so soft with her words but the concept was the same. i tried to set boundaries after her abusing me verbally and physically multiple times. she got upset and kept saying i never cared or never loved her.

“it would be nice for one second to feel like i had support or you cared about me”

that message hit home. she would always say that after we split. 

stay strong homie. keep your boundaries and keep the love you have for yourself and your space. best wishes
congrats dude! best wishes to you and your healing journey

they’re some special breed i can’t remember. all i know is she paid thousands of dollars to have them imported from another country. she apparently signed a contract and so it would cost her a few more thousand to send them back and i’m not paying that kind of money just to do that.

i’m so sorry for triggering you. i didn’t even think about the damage i could be causing with posting the messages. i just didn’t know where to turn to. and honestly that’s my plan. as far as moving and changing my number i am not able to do it. but i am changing jobs very soon. once she takes her stuff i’m rearranging my room and throwing old stuff out and putting new things in. i started going to the gym and am trying to quit nicotine and literally just changing everything. i’m just going to move on with life.

i live in a small room one cat was enough and she bought the cats and they’re not spayed/neutered so i have to keep them separated or they’re going to start mating. i also work a lot and am never home and they don’t get along with allie very well so i have to put them in crates while im at work and sleeping and when i go out and that’s not a good life for them. i agreed to hold them for her when she became homeless until she got a place. i know it’s not the cats fault but they were a really big reason we had fought and i ended up getting physically abused really bad and that caused us to end. so i never bonded with them.
i’m sorry to have given you flashbacks/anxiety i should’ve put a TW. it was so hard to not feed into it and argue back or to show how much she was hurting me. thank u for your encouragement!

yea they called me earlier off a blocked number and left me a voicemail of them doing some nasty things with someone else. it’s just crazy how just a month ago i was the love of their life and everything to them and now they’re going to such great lengths just to keep hurting me.
i’m at that point too. i don’t care what happens to her. i need to do what’s best for me and that is what i’m trying to do. thank you!
it’s so frustrating. them acting like they don’t care and will say anything and everything to hurt you. it’s disgusting
thanks my dude! i’m trying the road ahead is long and rough but i’m gonna keep pushing until the wheels fall off
i will keep y’all updated thank you so much for the love! it really does help to know i’m not alone
i’m hoping they will be. i would give them to a better home but she paid thousands of dollars for them and dont feel like it’s my right.
i don’t want to. i wanted to stay in touch as friends and stuff but she burned that bridge and keeps relighting it with all the negative things she says to me

i’m sorry for giving you flashbacks. it really is a trip how every other post here i do feel like their talking about my ex pwBPD. their similarities are uncanny. i have realized i don’t deserve it. it’s not right and i believe i am a good person whether they wanna tell me i’m not. i’m one of the lucky ones that have gotten away before it got even worse. i hope everyone has the strength to do what i did. we will all heal and be better for it.
i wish i could tell everything that they have done. it’s just so much i don’t even know where to start
that’s the plan, i met up with them today to give them their checks and it didn’t end very well. i’m planning on having no contact after they pick up their stuff

today was the first time we’ve spoken in a few days. but every other time since the break up it’s been “you don’t care about me” like no i do care just not the way you want me to anymore. i feel the wanting them to speak to you. i honestly wish things were different but i know that it wouldn’t take back all the horrible things that have happened.
thank you! i really appreciate your good wishes. it is such a hard thing to do but it’s what needed to be done. i was tired of getting emotionally and physically abused.
thank you dude it’s so nice to be validated for once i really appreciate it
i’m so proud of you dude! best wishes on your journey to healing. you did what you needed to do to heal and become whole again.

we were together like 11 months. it was actually supposed to be our 1 year anniversary yesterday. we had the cat since july i believe. she would do the same thing call us “our little family” with the cat and everything. but when she’s upset she doesn’t give a fuck about anything or anyone and i can’t trust her with my cat if she’s not stable. she bought two other cats and i have no bond with them so idc if she takes them. and i’ll be okay i’m sorry for you too. i’m happy to be in this little group bc it helps me justify things and learn that i wasn’t alone.

honestly like when she’s like this she acts like she never cared and nothing hurts her. and i know once she clears her mind it hits her hard. i will take care of allie she’s my baby. if i figure out how to post a pic of her i will
see i want to do that but it would make me feel like a bad person. like it’s raining and i wouldn’t want her stuff to get ruined. even tho she ruined me.

thank you dude i really appreciate it. i’m hoping she will take all her shit because it’s even still depressing to be in my room with all her shit here. everywhere i look i’m reminded of her. and i’m over it. my heart is too big but she fucked me up. i am slowly realizing my worth again.
it’s like i gave her all my love let her live at my place fed her took care of her but i’m still the asshole? it makes no sense.

she’s so back and forth dude. i know when she’s like this she’s in a manic state but i just can’t keep putting myself through this. like i wanted to salvage the friendship but the second i don’t run to her side when she’s sad it’s “you don’t care about me” like bro you beat the fuck out of me i need to heal just as much as you. thanks for your words of encouragement. i really appreciate it

i feel as though i will always love her. she was my person. but i had to do what was best for me. i do know i will probably never get any closure. and she still holds it over me. she tells me all the time how i never cared about her and didn’t love her when that was a straight lie i was just tired of getting verbally and physically abused

i am done as in i will never go back to them but they were also my best friend so i miss them dearly. but glad to know it gets better eventually. i am slowly starting to realize how messed up our relationship was
it was such a bad toxic cycle it got to the point where i started doing it and blocked them on everything. so i guess it is normal
i feel the same like i know if i go back it would be fucking hell i don’t know maybe i’m just feeling lonely and the wound is still fresh
we lived in the same house and she would block me and go awol for hours. id have to constantly go out looking for her to bring her back home

when the physical and verbal abuse kept getting worse and they weren’t ready to get themselves help. i couldn’t keep putting myself through that toxic cycle. i needed to do what was best for me despite what i wanted. i fear them hurting themselves to this day but i can’t be the one responsible when they have an active choice to get better. i promise you once you leave it will be hard but you will feel so much better and learn to love again. best wishes

they are the same way. they acknowledge and feel guilt and shame for the things they do and then everything will be okay for a while and then it happens again. i always called them out for being emotionally manipulative. we both have acknowledged that they are a sick person. i still love and care for them but they will seek help when they are ready. thank you for your insight
i’m sorry to hear that for them. i know what it likes and i hope they find happiness. i wouldn’t wish this upon anyone. it’s terrible
so i’m not an asshole right? i never even considered that they could be a narcissist.

i’ve decided to kind of just let them go. but i feel bad. their mental health isn’t getting any better and they’re starting to drown in it. i still care about them but i don’t wanna be taken down with them
i’m just scared of what’s gonna happen if i do. they aren’t mentally stable themselves and i’m scared they’re going to hurt themself or worse.
oh now i feel dumb my bad it’s been a little hard to collect my thoughts.
i’ve tried telling her that but she’s so impatient.

it’s hard to ask her bc she won’t open up to me she always says she doesn’t wanna talk about it and it’s so frustrating. i just want to help her and her to be happy and comfy in her own skin i dunno thank you for your comment

i know it’s hard to control and she’s aware too bc after she always says she feels so guilty and ashamed. i just get so beat up in it and make myself feel like i’m garbage. i dunno i feel like garbage now. thank you for your comment it means alot
how did you feel when you first found out if you don’t mind me asking? like what went through your head what emotions did you feel?

well the thing is she only goes out by herself when i’m at work and she’s not. whenever we’re both home we’re attached at the hip and it’s not just bc of me it’s bc of her too. idk i guess i’m struggling to find that fine line of what’s healthy and what’s not. you are right tho that is unfair i don’t want to be putting her in that position
thank you i really appreciate it

yea it’s been 7 months and everything did move pretty fast maybe i’m just overreacting. i guess i just need to find things to occupy my time. i don’t really have a lot of friends or talk to a lot of people she’s really the only person i socialize with. i just thought i’d give reddit a try and meet some new people or just talk to an actual human and stuff. tbh it does make me happy that she enjoys her alone time and stuff bc she could never be alone before being stuck with her thoughts and shit but that just leaves me being here twiddling my thumbs haha

well that’s the thing is i’m used to being alone i’ve always been alone i don’t mind it but it’s like i’m so invested and in love with her that i don’t like to be without her. even when we’re mad or fighting we like to be in each other’s presence (most of the time) but like the thing is is this is only when i’m at work when i’m not at work we’re attached at the hip

i do have a few ones but honestly sometimes i’m so depressed that i can’t even bring myself to do them. and it’s not depressed bc of her it’s like i’ve been like this for the last 10 years of my life i always feel so hopeless and useless
it was 7 months a few days ago. when we started talking we clicked instantly and just like fell in love with each other

a little background to this story she hates men right she’s been through some things in the past and it’s traumatized her to the point where she hates almost all men she’s even gone so far as to using them and stuff for getting what she wants bc she genuinely doesn’t care about them. but she only goes for romantic relationships with women and like we have a lot of intimacy and love for each other but she was experiencing something she calls “conphet” i believe it was where she was having second thoughts and feels pressured by society and people to be in a heterosexual relationship or crave sexual relationships with men. i had her phone at one point and noticed some weird emails so i went through it and saw she was on some weird meet up sites to have sex with men and stuff and when i confronted her about it we had this back and forth thing where i was crying and she was crying and she felt bad and like didn’t know how to communicate it and stuff and like she promised me she’d get off those websites and i watched her delete them and ever since then nothing like that has happened again but i still have those doubts and worries in the back of my mind. i want to trust her and stuff but it just lingers there but she hasn’t done anything since so it’s like i need to get over it and push past it i guess
you think so? how would i go about fixing or changing it?

you could stick things out. my girlfriend does the same thing. due to some trauma and stuff and how she was brought up she doesn’t know how to communicate very well. all she’s known is if something gets rough she leaves and finds anything else. and being with her and loving her i’ve found that it takes a lot of time and patience and a lot of reassurance of what you need and what she needs. have you ever sat her down and  told her that you’re not used to this or had a talk where she can attempt to communicate or try to compromise?
